signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a residential frontage: a yellow Cape Cod style house with a white picket fence, and a detached garage at the end of an asphalt driveway.
signals.notes: A white van and a car are parked along the fence at the far left, next door and not at this property; the house looks well kept, with a trimmed hedge along the driveway and a utility pole in the front yard.
